'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Three civilians are killed and 31 others are injured in a Russian [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] of [[Kharkiv]]. The city's mayor says that the latest shelling has targeted civilian infrastructure. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/russian-bombardment-kills-3-in-ukraine-s-second-city-kharkiv/47742224 (SwissInfo)]
***[[Russian occupation of Kharkiv Oblast]]
****The Russian-appointed military-civilian administration leader of [[Velykyi Burluk]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]], Yevgeny Yunakov, is [[assassination|assassinated]] in a [[car bomb]]ing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/leader-russian-occupied-ukrainian-town-killed-by-car-bomb-tass-2022-07-11/ (Reuters)]
***[[2022 Ukrainian summer counteroffensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces]] recapture the town of Ivanivka in [[Kherson Oblast]] after launching a counter-offensive against [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-recaptured-village-occupied-kherson-region-2022-07-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[National Army of Colombia|Colombian Army]] launches an [[airstrike]] on a [[FARC dissidents]]' camp in the [[Caquetá Department]], killing ten people. Iván Mordisco, one of the group's leaders, was at the scene during the strike; his fate is unknown. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-62120054 (BBC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Premier of New South Wales|New South Wales premier]] [[Dominic Perrottet]] announces that the [[Australian Aboriginal Flag]] will be flown permanently above the [[Sydney Harbour Bridge]], which is widely regarded as an iconic [[Australia]]n landmark. The flag will be flown on top of the bridge's arches alongside the [[Flag of Australia|national flag]], replacing the [[flag of New South Wales]], after the [[Government of New South Wales|state government]] decided against accommodating all three flags. [https://edition.cnn.com/style/article/aboriginal-flag-sydney-harbour-bridge-australia/index.html (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*A [[Judiciary of Russia|Russian court]] lifts the suspension for the [[Caspian Pipeline Consortium|CPC]] pipeline and instead fines its operators 200,000 rubles ($3,300) for [[oil spill]]s. The [[oil pipeline]], one of the world's largest, is the route for nearly all of [[Kazakhstan]]'s oil exports, which represents about 1% of [[global oil supply]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-majors-face-output-slump-deep-losses-if-russia-stops-kazakh-pipeline-2022-07-11/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Nord Stream 1]] [[natural gas pipeline]] from [[Russia]] to [[Germany]] is suspended for the first of ten days of scheduled annual maintenance. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/europe-edge-nord-stream-russian-gas-link-set-planned-shut-down-2022-07-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 European heat wave]]
**[[France|French]] authorities issue a warning as temperatures reach as high as {{convert|40|°C|°F}} amid ongoing [[wildfire]]s. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20220711-france-to-face-new-long-heatwave-starting-monday (RFI)]
*Two people are killed and four others are injured after a three car pileup caused by a pack of boars north of [[Thessaloniki]], [[Greece]]. [https://apnews.com/article/health-greece-accidents-thessaloniki-a87acb5a3ff0f797f40b349f88ca36b1 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] announces that the United States will purchase 3.2 million doses of the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine]] once the vaccine is approved. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/07/11/science/novavax-covid-vaccine.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Macau]]
***[[Macau]] closes all of its casinos in order to contain an outbreak of [[COVID-19]] in the city. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/macau-shuts-all-its-casinos-in-race-to-curb-covid-19-spread (''Straits Times'')]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[New Mexico]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.krqe.com/health/first-probable-monkeypox-case-reported-in-new-mexico/ (KRQE-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Lithuania–Russia relations]]
***[[Lithuania]] expands sanctions on the Russian [[Enclave and exclave|exclave]] of [[Kaliningrad Oblast|Kaliningrad]] to include cement, concrete, wood, alcohol and alcohol-based industrial chemicals. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lithuania-expands-restrictions-kaliningrad-trade-2022-07-11/ (Reuters)]
*The [[51st Pacific Islands Forum]] begins in [[Suva]], [[Fiji]], amid escalating geopolitical competition between [[China]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/7/11/pacific-islands-summit-begins-amid-us-china-battle-for-influence (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Russia]]
**Lawmakers in Russia propose to extend the anti-"[[Russian gay propaganda law|gay propaganda]]" bill to all people regardless of their age. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/11/russia-proposes-extending-gay-propaganda-law-to-all-adults (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 vote of no confidence in the government of Élisabeth Borne]] 
**The [[Borne government|French government]] survives a no confidence vote tabled by the [[Left-wing politics|left-wing]] [[New Ecologic and Social People's Union|NUPES]] coalition. The no confidence vote received only 146 ''yes'' votes out of the 289 needed. [https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/live/2022/07/11/l-assemblee-nationale-en-direct-la-motion-de-censure-de-la-nupes-rejetee-le-gouvernement-se-dit-au-travail_6134252_823448.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a decree extending a fast-track process to obtain Russian citizenship to all [[Ukrainians]], which previously only applied to those living in the [[Donetsk People's Republic]] and the [[Luhansk People's Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-decree-gives-all-ukrainians-path-russian-citizenship-2022-07-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] releases [[Webb's First Deep Field|the first full-color image]] taken by the [[James Webb Space Telescope]], showing a segment of a [[galaxy cluster]] 4.6 billion [[light-year]]s away from [[Earth]]. [https://www.theverge.com/2022/7/11/23202949/nasa-jwst-first-image-joe-biden-universe-deep-field (''The Verge'')]
